title: Beyond Local Accuracy: Benchmarking the Rollout Reliability of PDE Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: PDE foundation models enable data-efficient adaptation but are deployed autoregressively, so short-horizon accuracy need not imply reliable simulation. We ask whether the short-horizon advantage of a foundation-model recipe persists when its predictions are repeatedly fed back as inputs for a long horizon. We define error amplification as G=E(H_f)/E(H_s), which measures full-horizon error relative to short-horizon error. We evaluate seven models on seven two-dimensional time-dependent PDE datasets: scratch-trained FNO and DeepONet; fine-tuned DPOT, GPhyT, Poseidon, and Walrus; and frozen in-context VICON. We report VRMSE, relative L_2, and relative MAE. Six datasets provide paired short- and full-horizon scores, while CE-RM contributes short-rollout sweeps only. translated_title: 超越局部精度：PDE基础模型滚动预测可靠性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）基础模型能够实现数据高效的适配，但其部署方式是自回归的，因此短时程精度并不一定意味着可靠的仿真。我们提出这样一个问题：当把基础模型方法的预测反复反馈作为输入进行长时程预测时，其短时程优势是否仍然能够保持。我们将误差放大定义为 G=E(H_f)/E(H_s)，用于衡量全时程误差相对于短时程误差的比值。我们在七个二维时变PDE数据集上评估了七个模型：从零训练的FNO和DeepONet；微调的DPOT、GPhyT、Poseidon和Walrus；以及冻结的上下文学习模型VICON。我们报告了VRMSE、相对L_2和相对MAE指标。其中六个数据集提供了配对的短时程与全时程评分，而CE-RM仅提供短时程滚动扫描。在所有指标下，至少有一个微调的基础模型在30个短时程滚动“数据集-预算”组合中的26个里优于两个从零训练的基线模型。然而，全时程VRMSE……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究提出“误差放大”指标G来基准测试PDE基础模型在自回归滚动预测中的可靠性，发现尽管微调的基础模型在短时程预测中普遍优于从零训练的基线模型，但其短时程优势未必能在长时程滚动中保持。
en_tdlr: This work benchmarks the rollout reliability of PDE foundation models using an error amplification metric G, showing that although fine-tuned foundation models generally outperform scratch-trained baselines at short horizons, their advantage does not necessarily persist under long-horizon autoregressive rollout.
